trans-unit.source: Security services are crucial for safeguarding your online experience. These services help protect your data and privacy by detecting and preventing security threats, such as malware, phishing attempts, and unauthorized access. They ensure a safer browsing environment.

Osiguravaju sigurnije okruženje za pregledavanje.

trans-unit.source: Live chat services enable real-time communication with website support teams. They offer a convenient way to ask questions, seek assistance, or engage in discussions while browsing a website. Live chat enhances your online interaction and customer support experience.

Nude praktičan način za postavljanje pitanja, traženje pomoći ili sudjelovanje u razgovorima tijekom pregledavanja web-stranice. Chat uživo poboljšava vašu internetsku interakciju i iskustvo korisničke podrške.

trans-unit.source: Adobe Fonts provides web fonts used for this website. When enabled, font files are loaded from Adobe and technical connection data may be processed.

trans-unit.source: Google AdSense enables personalized ads on websites while respecting user privacy. By consenting, you allow relevant ads and help support free content.

trans-unit.source: Consent to the use of surveillance camera images for security and safety purposes, in compliance with applicable data privacy regulations.

trans-unit.source: Career Captain provides gamified career orientation and recruiting content. When enabled, external content from Career Captain may process usage and technical connection data.

trans-unit.source: Microsoft Clarity is a user-friendly web analytics tool that empowers website visitors like you by providing transparency about how your interactions are tracked on a website. It ensures your privacy is respected while giving developers and website owners valuable insights into user behavior. Plus, it follows coding guidelines and best practices, ensuring a safe and secure online experience for you.
trans-unit.target: Microsoft Clarity je alat za web-analitiku jednostavan za korisnike koji posjetiteljima web-stranice pruža transparentnost o tome kako se prate njihove interakcije na web-stranici. Poštuje vašu privatnost i razvojnim programerima te vlasnicima web-stranica daje vrijedne uvide u ponašanje korisnika. Osim toga, slijedi smjernice kodiranja i najbolje prakse, osiguravajući vam sigurno internetsko iskustvo.

trans-unit.source: Cloudflare helps protect and optimize websites. By using this website, you consent to Cloudflare's data processing practices as described in its Privacy Policy.
trans-unit.target: Cloudflare pomaže zaštititi i optimizirati web-stranice. Upotrebom ove web-stranice pristajete na Cloudflareovu obradu podataka kako je opisano u njegovim pravilima privatnosti.

trans-unit.source: Simplifies web tracking for analytics and marketing while ensuring data compliance and control.
trans-unit.target: Pojednostavljuje web-praćenje za analitiku i marketing, uz osiguravanje usklađenosti podataka i kontrole.

trans-unit.source: Fast Fonts, operated by fonts.com and supplied by fast.fonts.net, is a service for the provision of web fonts. It requires the use of a pixel-code for continuous price calculation.
trans-unit.target: Fast Fonts, kojim upravlja fonts.com i koji isporučuje fast.fonts.net, usluga je za pružanje web-fontova. Za kontinuirani izračun cijene zahtijeva upotrebu pixel koda.

trans-unit.source: Google Ads allows advertisers to reach their target audience online. To personalize ads and measure their effectiveness, Google may collect data with your consent.
trans-unit.target: Google Ads omogućuje oglašivačima da dosegnu svoju ciljnu publiku na internetu. Za personalizaciju oglasa i mjerenje njihove učinkovitosti Google može prikupljati podatke uz vašu privolu.

trans-unit.source: Web analytics service provided by Google, Inc. ("Google")
trans-unit.target: Usluga web-analitike koju pruža Google, Inc. ("Google")

trans-unit.source: Google Maps allows for the integration of interactive maps on websites, enabling location-based services. Developers can utilize it while ensuring data compliance and control, adhering to coding guidelines and best practices.
trans-unit.target: Google Maps omogućuje integraciju interaktivnih karata na web-stranice i usluge temeljene na lokaciji. Razvojni programeri mogu ga koristiti uz osiguravanje usklađenosti i kontrole podataka, pridržavajući se smjernica kodiranja i najboljih praksi.

trans-unit.source: Google Tag Manager streamlines web tracking and code management, ensuring data compliance and control for developers.
trans-unit.target: Google Tag Manager pojednostavljuje web-praćenje i upravljanje kodom, osiguravajući usklađenost i kontrolu podataka za razvojne programere.

trans-unit.source: X (formerly Twitter) is a social media platform that allows users to share and interact with short messages and multimedia content. Developers can integrate Twitter features into websites to enhance user engagement and real-time updates while maintaining data privacy compliance and adhering to coding guidelines.
trans-unit.target: X (ranije Twitter) je platforma društvenih mreža koja korisnicima omogućuje dijeljenje kratkih poruka i multimedijskog sadržaja te interakciju s njima. Razvojni programeri mogu integrirati Twitter značajke u web-stranice radi povećanja angažmana korisnika i ažuriranja u stvarnom vremenu, uz održavanje usklađenosti privatnosti podataka i pridržavanje smjernica kodiranja.

trans-unit.source: Userlike offers a live chat solution that enhances user interactions on websites.
trans-unit.target: Userlike nudi rješenje za chat uživo koje poboljšava interakcije korisnika na web-stranicama.

trans-unit.source: Popular video-sharing platform that offers a range of features for creators and developers to enhance video content on websites.
trans-unit.target: Popularna platforma za dijeljenje videozapisa koja nudi niz značajki za autore i razvojne programere za poboljšanje video sadržaja na web-stranicama.

trans-unit.target: Vodeća platforma za dijeljenje videozapisa za autore sadržaja i razvojne programere za poboljšanje korisničkog iskustva na web-stranicama.
